stem.en: The same coin stack is released with the same stretch of the rubber band on three surfaces. It goes 20 cm on wood, 35 cm on a laminated top and 60 cm on polished marble. On which surface is the friction smallest?

feedback.en: Right. The stack went farthest there, so its velocity fell most slowly: the friction is smallest.
The stack went farther on marble than on the laminated top, so marble has less friction.
The stack stopped soonest on wood. That means the friction there is the largest, not the smallest.

explanation.en: With the same push from the band, the stack goes farthest where the friction is smallest, because its velocity falls most slowly there. That is polished marble.

hints.en: Smaller friction lets the stack go farther.
